name: – Daniel Freund – After § 47 – Am 25
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 47 a. Recalls the temporary “solidarity contribution” introduced by Council Regulation (EU) 2022/1854 during the energy crisis, which applied to profits exceeding by more than 20% the average taxable profits of the previous reference period; notes that this measure generated approximately EUR 28 billion in revenues across the Union in 2022 and 2023; calls on the Commission to propose a renewed and updated framework for such a contribution, based on the average taxable profits generated in the fiscal years 2022 to 2025, applying the same threshold and ensuring that the applicable rate is not lower than the rate applied under Regulation (EU) 2022/1854, in order to address continued risks of excess profits in the fossil fuel sector and to ensure a fair contribution to public finances;
